name: Dream Big Gymnastics Camps
description_short: School-vacation day camp at a gymnastics gym in Cranston, RI. Campers learn gymnastics skills, do a ninja warrior obstacle course, and make an arts and crafts project, 8:30am–4pm, $75 per day.
